reason: Reproduced on cards.cancel-card-confirm: Esc closes the dialog and focus lands on the More button, which has aria-haspopup=true and aria-expanded=false. The Cancel card menuitem is not in the DOM while the dialog is open and the menu is hidden afterwards, so More, the control that opened the menu, is where focus belongs.
criterionAnalysis: 2.4.3 Focus Order asks that focus move in an order that preserves meaning and operability. After Esc, focus returns to the menu button that started the interaction, the pattern the ARIA Authoring Practices set for a menu button whose item opens a dialog. The menuitem the sweep expected cannot take focus because the menu closes when the item is chosen. 3.2.1 On Focus and 2.1.2 No Keyboard Trap are not in play: nothing changes on focus and Esc leaves the dialog. The dialog having no accessible name is a separate 4.1.2 question and not part of this finding.
